name: Battlefront Annihilation

detectability.signature: Continuous gamma-ray emission from matter-antimatter annihilation at boundary; intense positron flux detectable across enormous range

proximity: Gamma radiation levels rise sharply, requiring heavy shielding to avoid lethal exposure
Sensors saturate from the annihilation glow, creating blind spots in all directions relative to the pocket
Stray positrons interact with hull matter, causing localized micro-annihilation pitting
contact: Instantaneous and total annihilation of any normal matter entering the antimatter-dense zone
The resulting energy release is proportional to the mass of the entering object, creating secondary radiation hazards
No known shielding technology can survive contact with the pocket's core density
prolonged_exposure: Cumulative gamma radiation ensures lethal dose for all biological crew within hours even at the boundary
Hull micro-annihilation accelerates, compromising structural integrity within days
The pocket's fluctuating boundary may expand to engulf stationary vessels without warning

age: Approximately 350 years, consistent with a weapons-manufacturing catastrophe during the Third Compact Schism

behavior.cycle: Boundary oscillates with a period of approximately 6 standard hours, expanding and contracting by up to 200 km

phenomena: A permanent annihilation glow surrounds the pocket like a miniature sun, visible for millions of kilometers
Matter drawn inward by weak gravitational pull annihilates at the boundary, sustaining the glow indefinitely
Spectral analysis reveals the antimatter composition includes anti-iron and anti-carbon, suggesting manufactured origin
The pocket emits structured gamma-ray pulses during expansion phases that some analysts interpret as the death throes of the containment system that once held it
hazards: Any physical object entering the pocket is instantly and completely annihilated
Gamma radiation at the boundary exceeds lethal thresholds for all known biological life
The oscillating boundary makes safe standoff distances unreliable during expansion phases
opportunities: Controlled harvesting of annihilation energy at the boundary represents a theoretically limitless power source
The pocket's manufactured antimatter composition provides data on advanced antimatter production techniques
Study of the pocket's self-containment mechanism could revolutionize antimatter storage technology
known_incidents: The pocket was discovered when the antimatter foundry-station Prometheus Unbound suffered catastrophic containment failure during the Third Compact Schism, killing its crew of 8,000 and converting the entire station's antimatter stockpile into an uncontained pocket
Energy harvesting vessel Lamprey-3 successfully extracted 4.7 terajoules from the annihilation boundary before a boundary expansion event forced emergency withdrawal with 30% hull loss
description: Battlefront Annihilation is a spherical pocket of dense antimatter approximately 2,100 kilometers in radius, surrounded by a permanent halo of matter-antimatter annihilation light. The pocket glows like a small, furious star, radiating gamma rays and positron flux across tens of millions of kilometers. At its boundary, normal matter drifting inward from the interstellar medium meets the antimatter and is converted to pure energy in a continuous, blinding cascade.

The pocket pulses with a roughly six-hour cycle, its boundary expanding and contracting by up to 200 kilometers per oscillation. During expansion phases, the annihilation front advances outward, consuming any matter in its path and producing spike emissions of gamma radiation that can be detected across stellar distances. The oscillation is believed to be a relic of the containment system that once held this antimatter—a system whose structured failure created a kind of breathing rhythm that the pocket has maintained for centuries.

Battlefront Annihilation was created 350 years ago when the antimatter foundry-station Prometheus Unbound suffered catastrophic containment failure during the Third Compact Schism. The station had been manufacturing antimatter munitions for one of the warring factions. Whether the failure was sabotage, accident, or deliberate self-destruction by the crew to prevent capture remains debated. What is not debated is the result: 8,000 dead and the largest uncontained antimatter pocket in known space, still burning centuries later.

The pocket is surrounded by an exclusion zone enforced by automated warning buoys. Despite the extreme danger, energy-harvesting operations at the annihilation boundary have been attempted with mixed success, and the pocket's manufactured antimatter composition is studied remotely for insights into production techniques that died with the foundry's crew. Battlefront Annihilation stands as the most visible monument to the Third Compact Schism—a war whose weapons are still killing, long after the combatants have gone.
